evidence.title: KachaBazar — Full Stack Grocery Ecommerce Template (TailwindCSS, React, Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB)

name: KachaBazar — Full Stack Grocery Ecommerce Template
summary: Full stack MERN grocery ecommerce template: React/Next.js storefront, admin dashboard and Node.js + MongoDB REST API.
description: Gumroad product for a full stack grocery ecommerce template built with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS, plus an admin dashboard and a Node.js and MongoDB backend with REST API. The creator profile describes it as a production-ready ecommerce starter. The product page is JavaScript-rendered, so price and item-level details were not readable.
contains: storefront built with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS
backend and REST API on Node.js and MongoDB
creator: HtmlLover, full stack ecommerce template maker; product name KachaBazar
sold on Gumroad; price and further details not readable (JS-rendered page)
